research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Eightfold AI is researching systems and methods for generating job descriptions using large language model processes, as described in 'System, method, and computer program for large language model processes for...' which details pre-processing requests and generating prompts for language models. Additionally, 'System, method, and computer program for assisting interviewers' focuses on segmenting interview audio and tagging speakers to assist interviewers. These areas highlight advancements in AI-driven talent management.

overview_description.description:
Eightfold is a developer of a talent intelligence platform used to help companies find, recruit, and retain workers. Its platform bridges the talent gap by using the power of artificial intelligence which helps to turn talent management into a competitive advantage and enables clients to match candidates to the right roles.

Eightfold was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Eightfold AI provides a complete AI platform for talent management to help companies find, recruit, and retain workers.

product.name: Eightfold Talent Intelligence Platform
product.description: A cloud-based AI platform that analyzes talent data, skills, and career trajectories to support hiring, workforce planning, employee development, internal mobility, and retention.

product.name: Talent Acquisition
product.description: An AI-based recruiting solution for managing the requisition-to-hire process, including candidate sourcing, matching, screening, scheduling, and hiring.

product.name: Talent Management
product.description: An AI-powered talent management solution that helps organizations understand employee skills, support career growth, and manage internal mobility, succession, mentoring, and retention.

product.name: AI Interviewer
product.description: An AI recruiting agent that conducts and evaluates initial candidate interviews to increase screening capacity and reduce manual scheduling and interviewing work.

product.name: Resource Management
product.description: A skills-based workforce management solution that matches employees and other available talent to projects, assignments, and staffing requirements.

product.name: Workforce Exchange
product.description: A talent marketplace that connects job seekers, employers, employees, and career-support organizations through AI-based matching for jobs, skills, and workforce opportunities.
